content:
nina: quick note: devs hitting raw req ids in JS quickstart DEBUG logs when an HTTP retry fires. REDWOOD_REDACT=1 set but logs show the id. anyone seen this? :grimacing:

 david: can you paste a tiny repro log + how you start sampleapp?

 nina: repro: NODE_ENV=development REDWOOD_REDACT=1, trigger a client retry (first request 502). log: `DEBUG request=req_live_ab12 path=/v1/complete attempts=2`  req_live_ab12 should be [REDACTED].

 sam: sounds like ordering + clone issue. logger attaches formatter early; otel/redact hook installs later so structured fields escape. plus retry clone writes a nonstandard key (`x-rw-reqid-raw`) which scrubber ignores.

 david: fixes: call telemetry.bootstrap() sync at top of app start, normalize header keys on retry clone (lowercase + run redactHook), and add a lightweight logger fallback that regex-replaces reqid-like strings. opt-out via REDWOOD_LOGGER_SCRUB=false.

 nina: opened PR with bootstrap + clone-normalize + test: https://git.redwood/infra/sampleapp/pull/1450. CI?

 ci-bot: PR CI: linux green, mac flaky timeout.

 sam: validated locally on node18/20, debug logs now show `[REDACTED]`. please add quickstart blurb about init ordering. closing when docs updated. :white_check_mark:
